title: PNW Skydiving
specs: Jump from 14,000 feet with about a minute of freefall
Use of PAC750XL and Cessna 206 aircraft
Must be at least 18 years old
Maximum weight for tandem is 230 lbs; body type evaluated if over 200 lbs
Must hold at least a current USPA A License and have a current reserve repack for licensed jumpers
AFF students must be under 250 lbs and in good health
Big groups welcome for tandem skydiving; lots of space for friends and family

services.desc: Are you ready to experience the ultimate adventure? You’ve come to the right place! PNW Skydiving is the premier destination for tandem skydiving in Oregon and we can’t wait to jump with you! Located in the heart of Oregon’s beautiful Willamette Valley, PNW Skydiving is the ideal place to embark on your Oregon skydiving adventure. Our highly experienced team will ensure that your tandem skydiving experience is truly unforgettable! On the day of your big adventure, come at your scheduled time (no need to arrive early), dressed appropriately for the weather of the day, and wearing tennis shoes. services.desc: Please note: We are not offering AFF for the 2026 season. AFF will be back for the 2027 season. It is a tremendous achievement to become a licensed jumper and we are proud to welcome students into our family. We love training people who like to take control of their own lives and aren’t afraid of a challenge. The skydiving community is truly a family, with members from all walks of life. When you learn to skydive, you instantly have connections to smart, fun, interesting people all over the world. blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 14,000 feet with professional instructors or enroll in an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) course to learn to skydive and earn a license. The AFF course includes ground school and multiple jump levels with instructor assistance. Licensed jumpers can use the dropzone facilities and aircraft for their own jumps.
extraNote: No jumps when raining, very windy, or clouds lower than 9,000 feet · All refunds to credit or debit cards are subject to a 6% processing fee · $650 nonrefundable deposit for AFF first jump course · Waiver must be signed; must be 18 to sign waiver · At the dropzone, 30 minutes from Portland, Oregon · April 1st through the end of September for AFF training; tandem jumps year-round weather permitting
